responsibility: Implements global reassociation of arithmetic and logical expressions on GIMPLE SSA. It linearizes expression trees, canonicalizes subtracts and negations, ranks and reorders operands to expose common subexpressions, eliminates canceling or duplicate terms, optionally forms __builtin_powi patterns for repeated factors, repairs branch/negate side effects, and drives a pass whose goal is to improve later folding, CSE, vector reduction recognition, and math optimizations.
same_name_distinction: Implements the reassociation pass itself: expression linearization, operand reordering/ranking, cancellation and duplicate elimination, optional __builtin_powi formation, negate repropagation, branch fixups, and pass execution. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-reassoc.h, it contains the optimization algorithm and pass machinery rather than just shared support types/helpers.
